p02-sofia-is-short.observed_description: Sofia, hair in a neat high bun, in her bright blue blazer, white blouse, black trousers and black flats, stands flat-footed at the right of a light-oak library bookcase against a white wall and smiles up as her raised right hand holds a red book on the top shelf; a second bookcase fills the left third.
p02-sofia-is-short.rejection: She is not on tiptoe and her hand reaches and holds the red book on the top shelf, so the photo shows a woman taking a book, not a short woman who cannot reach; the bookcase was drawn to her reach. She also stands at the right edge instead of the center. The same bookcase design would make p01 (tall) read the same way, so p01 is held for a revised prompt.

p03-ana-has-long-hair.observed_description: Ana, a young woman in her sage-green overshirt over a white top and light-wash jeans, stands three-quarters turned away in a sunny green park with trees behind her and looks back over her shoulder with a warm smile; her long dark wavy hair falls past her shoulder blades and is the most obvious thing in the photo. Seen from head to upper thighs, centered.
p03-ana-has-long-hair.note: Usable. She is framed to the upper thighs rather than the knees, and part of her hair falls over her shoulder rather than straight down her back; the length still reads at 180 px and in the 4:5 crop.

p04-diego-has-a-beard.observed_description: Diego, in his dark navy blazer over a burgundy button shirt, faces the camera from the waist up in a bright cafe with plants, a wooden counter and an espresso machine behind him, smiling broadly; his short, full dark beard with grey at the chin covers his cheeks, chin and upper lip. Centered.
p04-diego-has-a-beard.note: Usable. A blurred chalkboard menu at the top right carries scribble-like marks; they are unreadable at every phone size and the centered 4:5 crop removes them.

p05-grandfather-old-man.observed_description: The grandfather, a very old man with thin white hair and a deeply lined face, in his white short-sleeved shirt and brown trousers, sits alone on a rough wooden bench on the terracotta tiles in front of the terracotta-orange house with open green doors and pink bougainvillea at the left, both hands on top of his wooden cane, smiling at the camera. Head to feet, centered; no flag, no suitcase.

p07-grandmother-old-woman.observed_description: The grandmother, a very old woman with white hair in a low bun, in her lavender blouse and long grey skirt, stands alone in the open green doorway of the terracotta-orange house with pink bougainvillea at the left and an open green-shuttered window at the right, hands at her sides, smiling at the camera. Head to feet; no flag, no suitcase.
p07-grandmother-old-woman.note: Usable. She is small in the frame (head to feet from a distance) and stands left of center; her white hair and age still read at 180 px, and the 4:5 crop keeps her whole near its left edge. Her hands hang at her sides instead of clasped.

p06-cousin-young-man.observed_description: The cousin, a slim teenage young man with short black curly hair and no beard, in his mustard-yellow T-shirt and dark jeans, stands alone on the terracotta tiles in front of the open green door and window of the terracotta-orange house, hands in his pockets, smiling broadly at the camera. Head to thighs, just right of center.
p06-cousin-young-man.note: Usable as asked; he reads clearly as a young man of about 19.
